name: prompt-1089
image_purpose: Conceptual social post and visual perspective experiment

prompt.project_info: Create a surreal-looking but photorealistic view from beneath a completely transparent plexiglass plane as multiple people walk overhead.
prompt.main_subject: Several approved adult pedestrians in casual summer clothing, captured from below as they walk across the transparent surface. Keep faces secondary and shoe soles, natural gait, clothing folds, and perspective geometry accurate.
prompt.composition_elements: Straight upward view with no visible plexiglass edges or separations, many feet and bodies approaching from left to right, shoe soles close to the foreground, and a pure blue sky with no buildings.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright clear daylight with crisp blue-sky reflections, natural shadows on the transparent plane, realistic slight perspective distortion, and playful impossible-view atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-wide rectilinear perspective, close focus on nearest soles, deep blue sky, realistic glass refraction and reflections without visible seams, high-detail photorealism, subtle film grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic surreal perspective from directly beneath a completely transparent plexiglass plane, looking straight up at several approved adult pedestrians walking across it. Their shoe soles and feet pass very close to the foreground, bodies move generally from left to right with natural gait and clothing folds, and the pure blue sky fills the background with no buildings. No visible plexiglass edges or separations, realistic transparent-surface reflections and shadows, accurate perspective, dynamic playful visual experiment, high-detail ultra-wide view, subtle film grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, unsafe falling, injury, distorted anatomy, malformed feet, extra limbs, impossible shoe geometry, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, celebrity likeness, low resolution, blur

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve the upward perspective, transparent plane illusion, pedestrian movement, shoe proximity, blue-sky background, and no-edge composition. The reference is replaceable with another approved adult crowd variation while retaining the same safe conceptual viewpoint. Explicitly define replacement identities, outfits, products, logos, environment, or typography; do not invent them.
